subtasks.title: Add Hit::scopeForHotlistOrgs and give CH forDispositions PG parity for 'New Hit' (Scout validDisposition SQL pinned)
subtasks.approach: In app/Clickhouse/Models/Hit.php add scopeForHotlistOrgs(Builder $query, array $orgIds): Builder mirroring Scan::scopeForOrgs (Scan.php:53-62): int-cast, unique, array_values; an empty set gives whereRaw('0 = 1'), otherwise whereIntegerInRaw('hotlist_org_id', $orgIds). Bare column, no FINAL. Separately, AC-7: CH scopeForDispositions (Hit.php:141-160) currently turns NEW_HIT into 'disposition IS NULL' only and drops the literal, while PG (app/Models/Hit.php:474-490) matches NULL OR the literal. Change the CH scope so a NEW_HIT selection keeps 'New Hit' in the IN-list: '(disposition IS NULL OR disposition IN ('New Hit', ...others))'. The null/[] branch stays unchanged. Caller check (grep): the CH Hit::forDispositions callers are Hit.php:68 (scopeValidDisposition) and HitsResource.php:429 (Hits list filter, both models). HitSearchTool.php:244 is the PG branch; its CH branch (:236-241) already uses actionableDisposition(), which includes the literal, so Otto already meets AC-7 and only needs a pin (t2). MissedOpportunityResource.php:278 runs on MissedOpportunity models (app/Models/MissedOpportunity.php:109, app/Clickhouse/Models/MissedOpportunity.php:98) and is unaffected. To keep Scout's canonical DEV-2080 rule identical, rewrite scopeValidDisposition as a direct whereRaw that emits exactly the SQL it emits today, '(disposition IS NULL OR disposition IN ('Valid'))', instead of routing through forDispositions. Trim the now-false sentence in the scopeActionableDisposition docblock (:88-92) that says forDispositions drops the literal. Keep docblocks sparse. Test first in the new CH-free ClickhouseHitQueryShapeTest (scope section).

subtasks.title: Route HitsListQuery by config and prune the CH query by hotlist_org_id (ship together)
subtasks.approach: HARD STOP: routing and prune land in this one node. In app/Support/Hits/HitsListQuery.php, shouldUseClickhouse() (:19-23) becomes config('app.experimental.clickhouse.hits', false) || session()->has('admin_impersonator'), the DEV-2591 idiom from ListScans.php:306-309. Keep the Pennant import because the PG path still uses HIT_ADDRESS_DISTANCE. In buildClickhouseQuery() (:36-46), chain ->forHotlistOrgs(self::hotlistOrgIds($user)) before the kept ->forKits($kitIds), and leave notNicb, the select list and the hit_type clauses unchanged. Add private static hotlistOrgIds(User $user): array returning the positive ints of {(int) $user->org_id} ∪ $user->org?->stagingOrgIds()->all() (Org::stagingOrgIds() reused UNCHANGED, 2h cache accepted per Q2) ∪ self::silentOrgIds(). Add private static silentOrgIds(): array as Cache::remember(self::SILENT_ORG_IDS_CACHE_KEY, now()->addMinutes(10), fn () => Org::query()->where('silent_hit_generation', true)->pluck('id')->map(intval(...))->all()), with a public const cache key so tests can forget it. The 10-minute TTL is global, not per-org: orgs has ~729k rows and 1 silent org, the flag rarely changes, and the Hits page polls every 10s. The user org is used instead of kits->pluck('org_id') because they are equivalent on this path (Q8, Kit.php:252-266, withShared=false). An empty kit list still gives '0 = 1' via forKits, and the predicate is AND-only, so it can never widen beyond PG (Q10). Never use forOrg()/forKitOrg(), and no FINAL. Tests: extend the CH-free ClickhouseRoutingTest with a HitsListQuery suite (drop the :20-22 'ListHits deliberately not covered' paragraph); add baseQuery-level cases to ClickhouseHitQueryShapeTest (hot and cold); in OttoSearchToolsTest add the CH-mode sibling plus the Otto AC-7 pin.

ship_gates: AC-6: prod CLICKHOUSE_HITS_ENABLED confirmed true (Dalton 2026-09-29) and left on, so the deploy flips every org and Otto to the CH Hits path. No staged rollout.
AC-8: merge/deploy only after DEV-2739's Path B (recovery_address) distance fix is live in prod (Q4.5).

QA before merge (Q3): read-only prod measurement for one representative org over 30d of hit ids on its kits whose hotlist_org_id falls outside the prune set (moved kits, revoked approvals, de-flagged silent orgs).

QA before merge (Q5): read-only prod EXPLAIN indexes=1 / read_rows on hits_cold before vs after the prune, interleaved, which also confirms the prod sort key (hotlist_org_id, toYYYYMM(hit_created_at), hit_created_at, id).
AC-3/AC-4 human QA: read-only PG-vs-CH aggregate comparison for a Staging-Live-bearing org, with every difference written up in the PR/build record (matrix below).
ac4_difference_matrix_document_only: 4.1 Hit types: CH keeps only L/H/Z/S; F/M/A/P/W exist only on PG under Type=All. Accepted, not wanted on the list.

4.3 Duplicates: no FINAL and no dedup. A hit id can list twice when hit_created_at moved (cards use uniqExact(id), so list rows can differ from card totals). Otto hydration limit(count($hitIds)) can be crowded. Documented, not fixed.
4.4 Status: CH hotlist_status is re-emitted by the MV with lag; PG reads live hotlist.status. Accepted.
4.5 Distance columns: CH lacks distance_from_given_miles/nearest_given_address, so Pro HIT_ADDRESS_DISTANCE orgs move to async Path B. Gated by AC-8.
4.6 Join differences: measured tiny (PG-only 0.009%, CH-only 0.11% over 7d).

Q3 prune drift: current-value prune drops hits whose derivation changed (moved kit, revoked approval, de-flagged silent org). Accepted like DEV-2615, and the new 10-min silent-org cache adds up to 10 min of lag on (de)flagging.
Staging lag: Org::stagingOrgIds() 2h cache means a new approval's S/Z hits can take up to 2h to appear on CH (Q2 accepted).
kit_org_id is scan-time on CH vs current on PG (the dispositionable check differs for moved kits).

sizing.reason: Two concerns: (a) routing + hotlist_org_id prune and (b) AC-7 'New Hit' parity, across 6 files (2 app, 4 test). That sits at the file threshold and over the concern threshold, but a PR split is wrong here. (a) is a hard stop: routing and prune must ship together. With prod CLICKHOUSE_HITS_ENABLED=true, the deploy moves every org onto the CH path, so shipping (a) without (b) would regress the Hits list 'New Hit' filter for all orgs. (b) is a ~10-line scope change the human put in this ticket. It stays one PR, split into 3 serial subtasks. Org.php is NOT touched: the silent-org lookup is a private static in HitsListQuery.
